chatter: Psst... tap the little plants. They giggle. I taught them that.
A farm is just a garden that believed in itself.
I counted your coins while you were away. All there. Probably.
The ducks are plotting something. It involves breadcrumbs.
Water is just sky juice for plants. Don't tell the pond I said that.
Golden plants are worth THREE times more. Luck loves a merger!
Your Fernwhisp winked at me. I winked back. We're friends now.
I tried napping in a flower once. 10/10. Petals make great blankets.
Moss says patience pays. He also said that three hours ago.
Wren dropped a letter in the pond again. The fish are very informed now.
If your board is full, sell the little ones. Room to grow!
Happy plants sell for more. Tap them. Spoil them. They deserve it.
I do my best thinking while flying in circles.
Sunberries taste like sunshine with a secret.
The windmill creaks in C major. Very musical.
Did you know Moonmelons glow a little at night? Now you do.
Bramble is coming. Hide the snacks. (Kidding. Mostly.)
Every merge is a tiny celebration. Pop!
I named a pebble Kevin. He's in the Succulent family now.
Rain would be nice, but dew works just as hard.
Your farm smells like morning. That's my favorite smell.
Tap-tap works just like dragging for merges. Lazy fingers welcome!
Bloom Burst is the BEST button. Press it and watch the fireworks.
The Solarium is basically a spa for fancy plants.
I saw a firefly doing loop-the-loops last night. Show-off.
Honeybloom Buds make the bees form an orderly queue. Remarkable.
Plant two of the same, squish them together, get a bigger one. Magic!
Renown means the valley is noticing you. Wave back.
Level up, farmer! New levels bring gifts. I checked. They're good.
Dewdrops are the farm's savings account. Slow and shiny.
A full board is a happy board. A merging board is happier.
The tortoise pays best. He just takes... his time.
Radishes are spicy little rebels. Respect.
I polished your coins. They were already shiny. I polished them anyway.
Selling a golden plant feels like catching a shooting star.
The pond ducks quack in harmony. Mostly. Duck #2 is tone-deaf.
Your plants grew while you slept. I watched. It was beautiful.
Fill orders to make friends AND coins. Best of both!
Crystal Succulents hum on sunny days. Listen closely.
New day, new seed prices! The early bird gets the cheap seeds.
I believe in you. The plants believe in you. The ducks are undecided.
That's a fine-looking Elderbloom. Frame it. (You can't. Sell it.)
Prismheart! The shiniest of them all. My eyes! My beautiful eyes!
Merging in waves from the smallest up makes the biggest cascades.
Take a breath. Watch the clouds. The farm can wait a minute.
hints: Merge two identical plants by dragging one onto the other — or tap one, then tap the other.
Seed packets get a little pricier each time you buy the same family in one day. Prices reset at midnight.
Golden merges happen about 3% of the time and sell for 3x. Lucky!
Tap plants to make them happy. Happy plants (80+) sell for a joyful 25% bonus.
Tier-4+ plants can move to the Solarium, where they earn Dewdrops even while you're away.
Orders want bundles of crops and plants. Fill them for coins, dew, and Renown.
Buy more plots from the Land Shop when your fields feel crowded.
Replay the tutorial anytime from Settings if you want a refresher.

tutorial.text: Hiii! I'm Pip! This is YOUR farm. Let me show you around — it'll take about three minutes. Tap Next! (Or Skip if you're in a hurry.)
tutorial.title: Welcome to Bloomville!

tutorial.text: This is the Potting House — your merge nursery. See those seed packets? Tap one to plant a seed on the board. Go on, try it!
tutorial.title: The Nursery

tutorial.text: Two plants of the same kind and size can merge! Drag one onto the other — or tap one, then tap its twin. Merge two now!
tutorial.title: First Merge

tutorial.text: Pop! Bigger plant! Now tap any plant a few times — see it giggle? Happy plants sell for a bonus. Joy is profitable.
tutorial.title: Happy Plants

tutorial.text: Back outside! Tap an empty soil plot and pick a crop seed. It grows INSTANTLY — no waiting around here.
tutorial.title: Crop Fields

tutorial.text: Tap the grown crop to harvest it! Watch it fly into your basket. Juicy!
tutorial.title: Harvest Time

tutorial.text: See the Farm Stand? Visitors post orders — bundles of crops and plants. Tap an order, then Fill it for coins, dew, and Renown!
tutorial.title: Visitor Orders

tutorial.text: Fancy plants (tier 4+) can retire to the Solarium, where they make Dewdrops passively — even while you're away.
tutorial.title: The Solarium

tutorial.text: The Codex tracks every plant and crop you discover. Silhouettes are mysteries waiting to happen.
tutorial.title: The Codex

tutorial.text: That's everything! Merge, grow, harvest, fill orders, and watch Bloomville bloom. I'll be flying around if you need me!
tutorial.title: You're Ready!
